name: estimation
notes: Owns job templates and internal cost estimates. Does not create quotations or tax. Estimate numbers come from the number series ESTIMATE; a revision keeps the number and raises its revision. lead_id and party_id are plain references with no foreign keys into other modules. The default overhead, contingency and target margin are the typed settings estimation.overhead_percent, estimation.contingency_percent and estimation.target_margin_percent (H-15).
